messages.subject: fast intro to Stan (slides + audio)
parts:
This one was presented a couple months ago at the Stat Society
of Australia, Victoria Branch (in Melbourne).

https://vimeo.com/ssavic/20150428-carpenter

It's just the slides (you can't see me), and I went pretty fast
on purpose partly because the audience was full of seasoned applied
statisticians and partly in reaction to having gone far too slowly
in the New South Wales (Sydney) version of the same talk.

Thanks to Damjan Vukcevic for organizing the talk and getting the
video together.

- Bob
